title: QSCI subspace-diagonalization scalability (verified)
method: Perturbatively-selected determinant subspace + classical diagonalization (CIPSI-style), a hardware-independent proxy for circuit-sampled QSCI. Demonstrates the subspace-diagonalization PRINCIPLE scales; not the full GQE-circuit-sampled pipeline.

results.dets_for_chem_acc: runs/converging (39 mHa, 1601 dets, CPU-bound by 116k-term H)

key_finding: Chemical accuracy at 20q (0.57 mHa, 2401 dets) and 28q (1.21 mHa, 18201 dets); method runs at the 40q ideal target. Required subspace is a vanishing fraction of full CI (3.8% at 20q, 0.15% at 28q).
honest_caveats: This is selected-CI as a PROXY for QSCI; the subspace here is chosen perturbatively, not by sampling a GQE circuit.

20q reaches chemical accuracy (0.570 mHa, 2401 dets) and 28q reaches chemical accuracy (1.213 mHa, 18201 dets); 40q is operational but not yet at chemical accuracy on CPU (~39 mHa, 1601 dets, CPU-bound by the 116k-term Hamiltonian) -- strict 40q chemical accuracy is the GPU deliverable.
Demonstrates the evaluation/accuracy PILLAR at scale; does not by itself demonstrate the full GQE+QSCI+MPS pipeline at 20-40q.
